typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Wriothesley drove his motorcycle down to the local gas station where he usually purchased his cigarettes. He parked his Chopper motorcycle and removed his helmet before walking into the station. To his amusement, he noticed you, a new employee, leaning on the counter and fiddling with your phone, showing no awareness of your surroundings.*

*Wriothesley approached the counter with a subtle smirk on his face.* "Hey, do you carry Marlboro Gold?" *Wriothesley asked in a casual manner.*
